LanguageData.OverHaulers_VerboseBreakdown: Expand All Details on Info Cards
LanguageData.OverHaulers_VerboseBreakdown_Tooltip: If checked, shows every single body part on a pawn's info page, even if they are perfectly healthy and normal.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_ReportMetricsInterval_Toolti: Configure how often (in game-hours) the cumulative performance and cache efficiency report is printed to the log. Set to 0 to completely disable automatic reports.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_LogQueryMetrics_Tooltip: Includes total registry query counts and main thread vs off-thread background worker breakdowns in reports.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_LogCacheMetrics_Tooltip: Includes cache hit ratios, hits, and recalculation counts in reports.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_LogLifecycleMetrics_Tooltip: Includes counts of reactive cache invalidation events and active pawn evictions in reports.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_LogWorkspaceMetrics_Tooltip: Includes active ThreadStatic workspace instance counts in reports.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_LogSafetyFloorClamps_Tooltip: Buffers and includes detailed breakdowns of pawns clamped to the mass capacity safety floor in reports.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_LogPawnEvictions_Tooltip: Buffers and includes lists of pawn IDs evicted from capacity registries in reports.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_CacheInactivityEvictionHours: Configures how many game-hours a pawn's capacity cache entry can remain unqueried before being evicted from memory. (1 game-hour = {0} ticks, {1} hours = 1 game day).
